issues.title: [FCD expansion] Discovery backlog: six groups and all research areas
issues.body:
Create and execute a discovery backlog across all identified groups. Owner authorization on 2026-11-05 is **research and recommendations only: do not add sources to the app**.

The backlog covers 20 content categories, 20 cross-cutting industries and nine USA/India public-information subtracks (49 tracked areas; overlapping classifications, not additive source quotas).

## Sequential group queue

1. #165 — Books, children's reading, textbooks and audiobooks. First ten persisted with 100 verified query examples; deferred/India gaps remain.
2. #166 — Learning and technical knowledge. Started: Wikipedia and Wikibooks each have ten verified query examples.
3. #167 — Industry and job knowledge. Queued.
4. #168 — Public information, civic records and maps. Queued.
5. #169 — Scholarly research. Queued.
6. #170 — Language, culture and educational media. Queued.

Every group's issue contains its complete area checklist and discovery acceptance. Public-information tracks each require USA/India and jurisdiction-specific coverage. Detailed source implementation tasks are created only when selected later.

## First batch delivered

[Ten source candidates and findings](https://github.com/ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web/blob/research/free-content-discovery-expansion/docs/research/free-content/batches/G01_FIRST_TEN.md): Global Digital Library, Wikisource, Library of Congress digital books, Biodiversity Heritage Library, LibriVox, African Minds, LSE Press, Mattering Press, mediastudies.press and punctum books. All returned real machine-query results; representative reading checks exposed text, PDF bytes or audio bytes. Five publishers share Thoth; Thoth is not an extra content origin.

[Query evidence](https://github.com/ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web/blob/research/free-content-discovery-expansion/docs/research/free-content/batches/G01_QUERY_EVIDENCE.json) and [access/paging evidence](https://github.com/ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web/blob/research/free-content-discovery-expansion/docs/research/free-content/batches/G01_ACCESS_EVIDENCE.json) retain reproducible requests, native IDs, small samples and observation dates. Full production qualification, broader relevance and country/access checks remain pending. Do not count these as enabled or assume all catalog records are eligible. India-owned current curriculum coverage remains a research gap.

References: [complete backlog](https://github.com/ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web/blob/research/free-content-discovery-expansion/docs/research/free-content/DISCOVERY_BACKLOG.md), [master plan](https://github.com/ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web/blob/research/free-content-discovery-expansion/docs/research/free-content/EXPANSION_PLAN.md), [execution workflow](https://github.com/ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web/blob/research/free-content-discovery-expansion/docs/research/free-content/EXECUTION_PLAN.md), [project 4](https://github.com/users/ddk220-light/projects/4), planning/research PR #161, parent feature #73.

No runtime sources, catalog imports, flags, deployment, new datastore or paid service changed.

## Ongoing goal and JSON registry, 2026-11-05

The owner authorized continued research and selected simple JSON files rather than SQL. [Registry](https://github.com/ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web/blob/research/free-content-discovery-expansion/docs/research/free-content/registry/README.md), [checkpoint](https://github.com/ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web/blob/research/free-content-discovery-expansion/docs/research/free-content/registry/PROGRESS.md), [goal](https://github.com/ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web/blob/research/free-content-discovery-expansion/docs/research/free-content/registry/goal.json).

- [x] Persist capabilities, exact query instructions, restrictions and evidence in Git.
- [x] Store ten verified query examples for each original source (100 examples).
- [x] Continue G02: Wikipedia and Wikibooks add 20 verified examples.
- [x] Record nine deferred candidates, 138 discovery/documentation links and all 49 research areas.
- [x] Save the ongoing goal and enable completion-driven hourly continuation with small durable checkpoints.
- [ ] Triage all linked and named/unlinked playbook leads into canonical source decisions.
- [ ] Continue G02–G06 and close explicit India/global/jurisdiction gaps.
- [ ] Expand toward 100 qualified origins per category/industry where evidence supports it; record genuine shortfalls without padding.

Current registry: 52 source records; 13 have ten verified query examples each (130 total); nine are deferred and 30 more historical catalog candidates have been backfilled. URLs/directories are not qualified sources. Eight failed query observations remain in history. Full relevance, reliability, rights and production qualification are still pending. No source activation is authorized by this goal. Offline validation and 14 evidence/inventory/capture tests pass.

## Complete-analysis goal, owner clarification

Populate the JSON/JSONL collection as the authoritative record of **all** free-content analysis, not merely a shortlist or a fixed daily source quota. The existing task is now “Complete source research registry,” enabled hourly. The manual run-now endpoint returned HTTP 404; the initial completion pass was executed directly in the active conversation.

- [x] Backfill full text/version/hash provenance for repository research/design analysis, structured evidence and a seven-issue backlog snapshot; index existing screenshots.
- [x] Map all 36 historical catalog rows, adding 30 source candidates without pretending old claims are freshly verified.
- [x] Add eight-part dossiers, source-specific passages and explicit unresolved questions to all 52 records.
- [x] Verify Python 3.15 documentation via its official inventory and ten actual local symbol queries; total 130 current examples across 13 sources.
- [x] Publish an auditable [completion report](https://github.com/ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web/blob/research/free-content-discovery-expansion/docs/research/free-content/registry/completion-audit.json) and [analysis manifest](https://github.com/ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web/blob/research/free-content-discovery-expansion/docs/research/free-content/registry/analysis/manifest.json).
- [ ] Reconcile every dossier's identity, coverage, query contract, rights/cost, access, quality/relevance, operating limits and decision/follow-up.
- [ ] Triage all remaining linked and unlinked leads; keep blocked/rejected decisions evidence-backed.
- [ ] Continue the full six-group expansion and close or explicitly accept coverage shortfalls before stopping.

Imported evidence is captured, but the broader analysis goal remains open. Candidate counts, ten query examples, or scheduling alone do not constitute completion. No production integration or SQL/hosted store.

issues.title: [FCD G01] Discover sources: Books, children's reading, textbooks and audiobooks
issues.body:
Backlog parent: #164. State: First ten persisted with ten verified query examples each; group remains open for deferred and coverage gaps.

[Category-specific discovery playbook](https://github.com/ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web/blob/research/free-content-discovery-expansion/docs/research/free-content/discovery/BOOKS_AND_AUDIO.md)

## Area backlog

- [ ] C01: Children's books and early literacy
- [ ] C02: General books and ebooks
- [ ] C04: Textbooks and scholarly books/chapters
- [ ] C05: Audiobooks and recorded books

Each checkbox means the area's first research pass is reviewed, not that 100 sources have been qualified. Source overlaps, languages and subtracks do not inflate global origin counts. Retain international and India coverage; public information uses USA and India with jurisdiction-specific scope.

## Discovery tasks for each selected area

- Select a bounded batch from its playbook's directories/networks; deduplicate origins and existing coverage.
- Inspect official retrieval documentation, metadata/content rights, free usage and operational limits.
- Perform real machine queries or permitted metadata-import search; record matching native IDs and query-specific results.
- Resolve representative items to usable full reading/listening/viewing destinations; keep free account, incomplete, loan and geographic conditions explicit.
- Record evidence, failed alternatives, coverage gaps and a ranked shortlist for owner review.

Current authorization is **discovery and recommendations only**. No source enablement, production change, new datastore, paid service, account creation or source outreach. Detailed integration stories come later. G01's first deliverable is ten candidates with demonstrated queryability, not full production certification.

## First batch evidence, 2026-11-05

- [x] Investigate candidates with official documentation and actual machine requests.
- [x] Identify ten queryable candidates and inspect representative reading access.
- [x] Record native identities, source/publisher distinctions, licensing, empty results, paging and failed alternatives.
- [x] Publish [the first-ten review packet](https://github.com/ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web/blob/research/free-content-discovery-expansion/docs/research/free-content/batches/G01_FIRST_TEN.md), [query evidence](https://github.com/ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web/blob/research/free-content-discovery-expansion/docs/research/free-content/batches/G01_QUERY_EVIDENCE.json) and [access evidence](https://github.com/ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web/blob/research/free-content-discovery-expansion/docs/research/free-content/batches/G01_ACCESS_EVIDENCE.json).
- [x] Owner reviewed the shortlist and requested persistent records and continued research.

Shortlist: Global Digital Library; Wikisource; Library of Congress digital books; Biodiversity Heritage Library; LibriVox; African Minds; LSE Press; Mattering Press; mediastudies.press; punctum books.

Five publishers use Thoth's API. The ten are probed candidates, not fully qualified/enabled sources or a claim of ten new unique publishers. Hindi/Tamil and historical India material were sampled; India-operated current-school-textbook coverage is still missing. Full relevance/quality/access benchmarks and any implementation remain future work. The former stop-after-ten checkpoint is superseded for research.

## Persistent evidence milestone

[JSON registry](https://github.com/ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web/blob/research/free-content-discovery-expansion/docs/research/free-content/registry/README.md): all original ten now have ten verified query examples each. Exact public requests, expected/matched native IDs, timestamps, response hashes and small outputs are stored as append-only JSONL. Failed attempts are retained; revised queries do not erase them. Nine deferred alternatives have separate source records and concrete next actions. SQL and hosted storage are unnecessary.

Known-title examples and LoC subject retrieval checks do not replace the full relevance/rights/access benchmark. G01 remains open for India-operated/current-curriculum coverage and other missing origins. Hourly completion-driven research continuation is recorded under the parent goal; no app enablement.

pull_request.body:
The research registry now verifies supported searches for **82 of 133 active connectors**, with 51 still blocked or failed. The fixed 44-connector recovery list has **16 working and 28 remaining**; every item has a saved recovery assessment. Search scopes, current request examples, failed attempts and next actions are tracked in Git JSON/JSONL and the generated connector status JSON/CSV.

This continuation adds six working searches:
- Bhuvan: local title/version search over 85 published product metadata entries.
- NYC City Planning: live zoning-map label searches in the public map-index dataset.
- ROSA P: documented OAI native-record metadata lookup; keyword search remains unverified.
- GSA FRPP: local fiscal-year/title search over 13 annual summary-dataset labels, without asset rows or spreadsheet downloads.
- DG Shipping/DGMA: current circular-title search over 18 dated metadata links, retaining native file versions.
- Seattle GeoData: documented public catalog keyword search followed by title-relevance filtering of the first three items. The title parameter's relevance failure and the corrected parser's earlier rejection are preserved.

There are **857 current passing examples**. NQR has nine successful keyword searches followed by an HTTP403; Gutendex has a successful native-ID lookup followed by another timeout. Both remain open. Provider-policy denials, inaccessible policy endpoints, outdated API documentation, login/partnership requirements and missing nonpersonal map interfaces remain explicit blockers. Historical claims and partial dossiers are retained without being promoted to complete.

Validation: capture → index → audit, registry validation, append-only history and unchanged activation checks; **299 research tests pass**. Research-only changes; no runtime imports, source activation, accounts, outreach, paid services or deployment. Hourly technical recovery remains enabled; the completed documentation queue/reporter remains stopped.
